one_line: A big-reaction news hook, a new shot for every claim, and a phone recording of the shop at the end.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a woman on a sofa, hands on her cheeks, mouth wide open, Giotto be-bè boxes in front; she holds one up at 0:01. Said (transcript): "סוף סוף אני יכולה לספר לכם על זה". Subtitle "סוף סוף" at 0:00.
q1_hook.why: An exaggerated face, a voice and news from the first second (H4, H1), said and subtitled at once (H6, T3). The brand boxes are in frame and one is held up at 0:01 (S1, H3). The question parents ask most promises an expert answer (K6), and the category is clear by 0:05 (H2).

beats.what: On the sofa, surprised face, holds up the Green Car box; "סוף סוף", the question
beats.why: News and the question parents ask, in one scene.

beats.what: Close-ups of boxes and tubs; "השתנה" in large blue: now sold in Israel
beats.why: The news lands with an enlarged word.

beats.what: Hands with pencils, then a toddler scribbling top-down; "המטרה", "להתנסות", "לאחוז"
beats.why: Reframes the goal: trying, not drawing well.

beats.what: A hand draws swirls with thick crayons; a crayon is snapped; "עבים ונוחים", "הצלחה"
beats.why: Each claim gets its own shot.

beats.what: Dough tub opened and kneaded; "וכמובן הם לא רעילים", "מרפאה בעיסוק"
Her toddler son draws from a tub of crayons; "סביב גיל שנה", "ילד מאוד אנרגטי"
beats.why: First-person proof from her own home.

beats.what: Another child cuts dough with safe scissors; "שלא תפספסו את ההשקה הזאת"
beats.why: Extra use, then the limited-stock nudge.

beats.what: Phone recording of the web shop, shekel prices, "אתר חדש", "Giotto"
beats.why: Shows where to buy and what it costs.

beats.what: Back to the boxes; "תכתבו לי", "לאתר", "ויאללה להתחיל לשנה הבאה!!"
beats.why: The ask, ending on a dated reason to buy.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Spoken and subtitled at 1:10: "תכתבו לי" for a link to the site. The caption opens with the questions parents ask her. No question to the viewer, no send or save ask.
q2_flow.why: A new picture every 2 s on average for each spoken claim keeps a long Reel moving (R3, E2, F8), and the facts come inside a mom-and-therapist story (K4). But five claims run for a minute before the shop at 1:04 (R1), and 74 s is long for one message (R2).

q3_cta.what: Spoken and subtitled at 1:10: "תכתבו לי", "לאתר", "ויאללה להתחיל לשנה הבאה!!". The shop recording at 1:04 to 1:10 carries "superkit.co.il". The visible caption names the new site by tag and has no comment word.
q3_cta.why: Said and shown after the value and the shop screen (C6), but "write to me" has no fixed word, so it is hard to automate (C3), and the site address is already on screen, a second route (C1). The text sits in the bottom 35% (F2).

q4_shown.what: Boxes and tubs from 0:00; crayons, pencils, dough and scissors in hands; a toddler scribbling, her own toddler son drawing, another child cutting dough; a phone recording of the shop with shekel prices and the site name from 1:04 to 1:10.
q4_shown.why: The product is on screen from 0:00 and used in several ways (S1, K5, F8). A first-person story from an occupational therapist who is also a mom, with her own child, vouches for it (S6, K8). The shop shows prices, but small, as ranges and without delivery (S3). Toddlers' faces are shown (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 39 shots in 74 s, 1.9 s average: on camera only in the first 6 s, then voiceover over b-roll, a 7 s shot of her son, a 6 s phone recording, the boxes again. Straight and jump cuts. Subtitles, some words enlarged.
q5_edit.why: A cut every 1 to 3 s with a matching picture per claim is quick, but it follows the sentences, not a rhythm (E2, R3). Short subtitles with enlarged words carry sound-off viewers (E4, T1, T2). It ends right after the CTA (E8) but is long (R2).

q6_topic.what: A new toddler art-materials line now sold in Israel, with an occupational therapist's reasons why it suits a one-year-old. Serves a parent choosing first art materials.
q6_topic.why: A question parents ask most (K6), an expert answer and a limited launch tied to "the year ahead" give a buying moment (K7). The developmental claims are modest and checkable (K4), told through a personal story (K2).

q7_filmed.what: A static medium shot on a sofa, to the lens, boxes in front. Then handheld top-down close-ups on a light table, clips of two toddlers at home with faces seen, a phone screen recording, the boxes on a carpet. Voiceover over most of it.
q7_filmed.why: The opening speaks to the lens with the brand in frame (F6, H3), and top-down hands make the thick crayons readable (F5, F4). Toddler clips are real home footage (H8, F7). Subtitles at about 71% down sit in the bottom 35% (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: White bold subtitles with a shadow, about 71% down, 1 to 3 words at a time, key words enlarged in blue: "סוף סוף" (0:00), "השתנה" (0:11), "המטרה" (0:16), "להתנסות" (0:19), "חשוב" (0:24), "הצלחה" (0:35), "ההתפתחותי" (0:44), "אתר חדש" (1:06), "Giotto" (1:08), "תכתבו לי" (1:10), "לשנה הבאה!!" (1:13).
q8_text.caption: "אחת השאלות שאני מקבלת הכי הרבה היא:". About 220 words, cut off in the data: two parent questions, the launch with tags @giotto_israel and @superkitcraft, why she likes the products, her own child's story. Hashtags and any disclosure line are not visible.
q8_text.why: Burned-in key words with the voice work muted (T1, T2), and enlarged words mark each claim, though they sit in the bottom 35% (T4, F2). The caption opens with the parent question (T7) and names the brand and shop by tag only, no partnership word seen (S7, T8).

weak_points: 74 s with five claims before the shop appears; "write to me" with no fixed word; small shop prices without delivery; subtitles in the bottom band; two toddlers' faces; partnership shown only by tags.
lumebook_takeaway: Open with a big reaction to the news, give each claim its own hands-only shot, end with a screen recording of the page and one comment word.
not_verified: Whether the voice over the b-roll is hers (it fits her story); the exact prices (small); whether the partnership was paid (a co-author is listed, no label, the caption in the data is cut off, so hashtags and any disclosure are unknown); music (none evident). Her son's name is said in the voiceover and caption and is not repeated here. Corrections to the first pass: she appears on camera only in the first 6 s; the shop recording runs 1:04 to 1:10; subtitles sit at about 71% down. Plays 7,682, likes 85, comments 23 on 15 Oct are context only. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
